entries.headline: Coded USAF broadcasts reported at nearly four times normal
entries.summary: War Watch reported coded US Air Force radio broadcasts at nearly four times their usual rate across nine regions, with four broadcasts heard in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Six USAF transports and elevated coded traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and 11 coded radio broadcasts logged that day, including two in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Six US cargo aircraft and one coded broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military cargo aircraft airborne over the United States, above normal numbers, and one coded radio broadcast heard in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Boeing C-32A using AF2 callsign spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing C-32A using callsign AF2, hex ADFEB8 and registration 98-0002, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Six USAF heavy-lift transports and six broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force heavy-lift transport aircraft airborne over the United States and six coded radio broadcasts heard earlier that day.

entries.headline: Six USAF heavy transports and earlier coded traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States, with coded radio traffic detected earlier that day but none in the preceding few hours.

entries.headline: Five coded USAF broadcasts and six transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five coded US Air Force radio broadcasts in the preceding hour and six transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea, including one near Saudi Arabia. The visible post is truncated after the word “regional”.

entries.headline: Four USAF transports and elevated Baltic activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and military activity over the Baltic Sea at nearly two and a half times normal levels.

entries.headline: EAM header code VQLYQV reported
entries.summary: War Watch posted an Emergency Action Message header/preamble alert with header code VQLYQV.

entries.headline: Six high-priority US military aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six high-priority US military aircraft airborne, including spy aircraft over the Baltic and transport aircraft, amid tensions involving Ukraine and Poland.

entries.headline: Six US aircraft, Baltic spy planes and North Sea command jet reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military aircraft airborne, including spy aircraft over the Baltic and a nuclear command aircraft over the North Sea. The visible post is truncated after the word “Middle”.

entries.headline: US transports, spy aircraft and surveillance drone reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport aircraft airborne alongside a spy aircraft and surveillance drone, with air activity near the Black Sea at nearly three times normal levels.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Chesapeake Ranch Estates
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military E-6 aircraft at Chesapeake Ranch Estates, United States. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on AEVEX Specter attack drone
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that AEVEX displayed its turbojet-powered Specter attack drone at AUSA.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report comparing Mojave and Gray Eagle UAVs
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Breaking Defense report comparing General Atomics’ Mojave STOL and Gray Eagle 25M unmanned aircraft.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on European U740 first flight
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a TWZ report that the European U740 variant of the XQ-58A Valkyrie completed its first flight in an Airbus-Kratos program.

entries.headline: E-3TF NATO03 on-ground alert at Gangelt
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for Luxembourg-registered military E-3TF aircraft NATO03 at Gangelt, Germany.

entries.headline: P-8 RFR7042 airborne alert at Greenwood
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for UK-registered military P-8 aircraft RFR7042 at Greenwood, CA.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Naguabo
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a US military E-6 aircraft at Naguabo, Puerto Rico. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: Boeing 737 airborne alert at Al Shamkhah City
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a United States-registered military Boeing 737 at Al Shamkhah City, AE. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on South Korea’s drone wingman test
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that Korea Aerospace Industries flew an FA-50 light fighter in formation with a jet-powered drone in its first manned-unmanned combination flight.

entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for Luxembourg-registered military E-3TF aircraft NATO03 at Geilenkirchen, Germany.
